next_step.title: Carry out Sheet 56, then the first COBI tab's UI pass
next_step.text: Sheet 56 asks whether to mock up the Fact Sheet on First Light's type with a dark mode. The next view the UI pass names is COBI's Dashboard tab.

calls.title: Read two records from the tab
calls.text: Irvine Valley's Art A.A. and Santa Monica's Barbering A.S. wait on your reading. Sign in on the Records view, open each record, and choose Confirm or Needs a fix.
calls.if_no_reply: Both records stay unchecked, and Sierra does not quote them.

calls.title: Answer Open Asks Sheet 56
calls.text: One card: mock up the Fact Sheet on First Light's type, light and dark, with the Word and PDF downloads unchanged?
calls.if_no_reply: The Fact Sheet keeps its document type and stays light.
